svg.title: How the pager works
svg.desc: GitHub sends the events of the GitHub App to the Worker on Cloudflare, signed with the secret of its webhook. The rules decide what needs Dennis; everything else ends there. What counts becomes one message in Telegram, edited in place as it changes, with buttons. A button runs an action of the allowlist on GitHub, such as merging a green release. Drafts, fixes and free text go to the workflow of the private control repository, which runs Claude Code with Dennis's subscription and sends its answer back, signed, as a draft or a note that a button has to approve.
